title: What Koine Greek is
subtitle: A reading language, not modern Greek conversation.
overview: Koine Greek is the common Greek of the New Testament era; this course is built to read it, not to learn modern Greek conversation.
The play button uses a natural modern-Greek neural voice. Use the written pronunciation key for seminary / Koine sound practice.

items.en: In the beginning was the Word.

items.grc: Ὁ λόγος ἦν πρὸς τὸν θεόν.
